# NumPy Arrays Extra Task 1 - Study Routine 

You will now write some a program using Numpy random functions. First, launch this page on Live Code or Binder:

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pxr687/Intro_Comp_Programming/refs/heads/main/images/launch.JPG)

## Instructions

Write a simple Python program using Numpy that works as a simple study routine scheduler.

- Import the NumPy library using the name `np`.

- Create an array called `subjects` containing the following subjects: `"Maths"`, `"Biology"`, `"Physics"`, `"English"`, `"Chemistry"`, and `"History"`.

- Create an array called `durations` containing the numbers 1, 2, 3, and 4, representing study hours.

- Use `np.random.choice()` to randomly select one subject from the subjects array.

- Use `np.random.choice()` again to randomly select a study duration from the durations array.

- Store the selected subject and duration in separate variables.

- Use an f-string to print a message in the following format:

`
"You should study SUBJECT for X hours today."
`

Replace SUBJECT with the randomly selected subject and X with the randomly selected duration. So, each time you run the program, it should display a message similar to one of the following:

`"You should study Maths for 2 hours today."`

`"You should study Chemistry for 4 hours today."`
